title: A Denny's, then a strange bet

shorts.title: A Denny's, then a strange bet
shorts.hook: PLANNED AT A DENNY'S. THEN A STRANGE BET.

beats.say: NVIDIA was planned at a Denny's. Then its boss made a strange bet.
beats.cap: NVIDIA was planned at a Denny's. Then its boss made a strange bet.

beats.say: In nineteen ninety three, Jensen Huang and two friends sketched a chip company over endless coffee. For years it made graphics chips for video games.
beats.cap: In 1993, Jensen Huang and two friends sketched a chip company over endless coffee. For years it made graphics chips for video games.

beats.say: But Jensen bet the same chips could do huge amounts of maths at once. In two thousand six, NVIDIA released CUDA so programmers could use them that way.
beats.cap: But Jensen bet the same chips could do huge amounts of maths at once. In 2006, NVIDIA released CUDA so programmers could use them that way.

In 2006, NVIDIA released CUDA so programmers could use them that way.

beats.say: Later, researchers trained a famous AI program, AlexNet, on two NVIDIA gaming cards. It turned out AI needed exactly that maths.
